title: Better Crafting Recipes
description: Adds balanced crafting recipes for vanilla items that are normally uncraftable or limited.
body:
# Better Crafting Recipes

Hi there! This mod adds new Minecraft recipes for items that are normally uncraftable, as well as a few recipe changes to make gameplay better and more convenient.

The idea of this mod is to keep Minecraft feeling vanilla while giving players a few more crafting options in survival.

![Banner Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3J4LK0So/images/7d7430b76fa138886a0c1e9898ffcb120f769831.png)

## What does this mod add?

This mod currently adds recipes for:

- Magma Block
- Elytra
- Enchanted Golden Apple
- Dragon Egg duplication
- Saddle duplication
- Totem of Undying
- Trident duplication
